description_for_human: Design RF block diagrams, synthesize cascades, calculate Friis noise figure, and simulate S-parameters.
description_for_model: RFBlock assists in RF system engineering. It synthesizes receiver/transmitter architectures, calculates Friis cascade budgets (Gain, Noise Figure, OIP3, OP1dB, Dynamic Range), runs scikit-rf multi-port linear S-parameter simulations, and streams live updates directly to the RFBlock canvas.
